title: Penalty for contravention of section 3.
text:
Where any foreign vessel is used in contravention of the provisions of section 3, the owner or master of such vessel shall,--

(a) in a case where such contravention takes place in any area within the territorial waters of India, be punishable with imprisonment for a term not exceeding three years or with fine not exceeding rupees fifteen lakhs or with both; and

(b) in a case where such contravention takes place in any area within the exclusive economic zone of India, be punishable with fine not exceeding rupees ten lakhs.

clauses.text: in a case where such contravention takes place in any area within the territorial waters of India, be punishable with imprisonment for a term not exceeding three years or with fine not exceeding rupees fifteen lakhs or with both;
in a case where such contravention takes place in any area within the exclusive economic zone of India, be punishable with fine not exceeding rupees ten lakhs.

conditions: A foreign vessel is used in contravention of the provisions of section 3.
The person subject to the provision is the owner or master of the vessel.
The applicable penalty depends on whether the contravention takes place within the territorial waters of India or within the exclusive economic zone of India.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
notes: Exact statutory text retrieved from the official India Code Section 10 record. This section provides the penalty for contravention of Section 3; it does not make a licence-not-produced fact alone sufficient to establish an offence.
